parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Fourth quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $280 million was 17 percent lower than prior-year period which included India.
Full year Adjusted EBITDA of $843 million was down 7 percent versus prior year.

parsed.notes: The excerpt has no reconciliation table; both figures come from the narrative text. Prior-year amounts are not printed, only percentage changes: Q4 down 17 percent and full year down 7 percent. The 2026 guidance ranges are forecasts and are excluded.
